resources.name: Open-source DFT code (Quantum ESPRESSO, GPAW, or CP2K)

access.notes: Any open-source DFT package that supports periodic solids, pseudopotentials, and spin-orbit coupling can be used. GPAW (https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/gpaw/) and CP2K (https://www.cp2k.org) are also suitable.

resources.name: Pseudopotential library (e.g., PSEUDODOJO or GBRV for PBE)

access.notes: Public pseudopotential files for the elements (Pb, I, N, C, H) needed for PBE DFT. Pre‑generated sets are available online.
